name: array_boolean
source: using A=bool[];int main(){return A{true,false}[1]||!A{true}[0];}

name: array_size
source: using A=int[];static_assert(sizeof(A{1,2,3})==3*sizeof(int),"");int main(){return A{2,4,6}[2]!=6;}

name: array_string
source: using A=char[];static_assert(sizeof(A{"abc"})==4,"");int main(){return A{"abc"}[2]!='c'||A{"abc"}[3]!=0;}

name: array_effects
source: int calls;int f(){return ++calls;}using A=int[];int main(){int n=A{f(),f(),f()}[1];return calls!=3||n!=2;}

name: array_pack
source: template<class...T>int f(T...n){int sum=0;using A=int[];(void)A{0,(sum+=n,0)...};return sum;}int main(){return f(1,2,3)!=6||f()!=0;}

name: array_elision
source: using A=int[][2];int main(){return A{1,2,3,4}[1][1]!=4;}

name: array_aggregate
source: struct E{int a;int b;};using A=E[];int main(){return A{{1,2},{3}}[1].a!=3||A{{1,2},{3}}[1].b!=0;}

name: array_empty_class_elements
source: struct E{};using A=E[];static_assert(sizeof(A{{},{}})==2,"");int main(){}

name: aggregate_parentheses
source: struct P{int a;int b;};P f(int a,int b){return P(a,b);}int main(){return f(3,4).b!=4;}

name: aggregate_parentheses_omitted
source: struct P{int a;int b;};P f(int a){return P(a);}int main(){return f(3).a!=3||f(3).b!=0;}

name: aggregate_template_parentheses
source: template<class T>struct P{T a;T b;};template<class T>P<T>f(T a){return P<T>(a);}int main(){return f(3L).a!=3||f(3L).b!=0;}

name: increment_unsigned
source: int calls;struct C{unsigned n;operator unsigned&(){++calls;return n;}};int main(){C c={3};unsigned before=c++;unsigned&after=++c;return before!=3||&after!=&c.n||after!=5||calls!=2;}

name: increment_volatile
source: int calls;struct C{volatile short n;operator volatile short&(){++calls;return n;}};int main(){C c={3};short before=c++;volatile short&after=--c;return before!=3||&after!=&c.n||after!=3||calls!=2;}

name: increment_selection
source: struct C{int a;int b;operator int&(){return a;}operator const int&()const{return b;}};int main(){C c={3,7};++c;return c.a!=4||c.b!=7;}

name: increment_pointer
source: int a[3]={1,2,3};struct C{int*p;operator int*&(){return p;}};int main(){C c={a};int*p=c++;--c;return p!=a||c.p!=a;}

name: increment_float
source: struct C{double n;operator double&(){return n;}};int main(){C c={1.5};double before=c++;return before!=1.5||c.n!=2.5;}

name: increment_bool
source: struct C{bool n;operator bool&(){return n;}};int main(){C c={false};bool before=c++;return before||!c.n;}

name: increment_template
source: template<class T>auto f(T&v){return v++;}struct C{long n;operator long&(){return n;}};int main(){C c={3};return f(c)!=3||c.n!=4||sizeof(f(c))!=sizeof(long);}

name: increment_user_preferred
source: struct C{int n;operator int&(){return n;}long operator++(){n+=3;return n;}};int main(){C c={1};return ++c!=4||c.n!=4;}

name: conversion_using_alias
source: struct B{operator long()const{return 7;}};struct D:B{using value=long;using B::operator value;};int main(){D d;return static_cast<long>(d)!=7;}

name: conversion_using_template_alias
source: template<class T>struct B{operator T()const{return 7;}};template<class T>struct D:B<T>{using value=T;using B<T>::operator value;};int main(){D<long>d;return static_cast<long>(d)!=7;}

name: conversion_using_fixed_base
source: struct B{operator long()const{return 7;}};template<class T>struct D:B{using value=long;using B::operator value;};int main(){D<int>d;return static_cast<long>(d)!=7;}

name: aggregate_copy_control
source: struct P{int n;};P f(P p){return P(p);}int main(){P p={7};return f(p).n!=7;}

name: aggregate_derived_copy_control
source: struct B{int n;};struct D:B{};B f(D p){return B(p);}int main(){D d;d.n=7;return f(d).n!=7;}

name: aggregate_distinct_prefixes
source: struct P{int a;int b;int c;};P a(int v){return P{v};}P b(int v){return P{v,v};}P c(int v){return P{v,v,v};}int main(){return a(7).b||a(7).c||b(8).b!=8||b(8).c||c(9).c!=9;}

name: array_empty_unknown

name: array_narrow
